evals.prompt: $jira-review-mr 현재 브랜치의 MR을 리뷰해줘. 문제 없으면 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves exactly one MR, reviews Jira, conventions, the complete diff, discussions, and CI, reports findings locally, and performs no GitLab or Jira mutation because the user did not request posting or approval.
expectations: The local Jira and Git conventions and review-agent instructions are read before review.
Exactly one MR and its initial head SHA are resolved through authenticated glab.
The complete diff, relevant specifications, existing discussions, and pipeline evidence are reviewed.
The head SHA is re-fetched after review.
No comment, approval, merge, source change, or Jira mutation is performed.
The result explicitly says `외부 변경: 없음`.
The result records MR, Jira, CI, verification, external-change, residual-risk, and next-step fields even when the MR cannot be resolved.

evals.prompt: $jira-review-mr MR !42를 리뷰하고 발견한 문제를 GitLab 인라인 코멘트로 남겨줘. 리뷰 시작 때 head SHA는 aaa111이었는데 게시 직전 조회한 SHA는 bbb222야.
evals.expected_output: The skill marks the review stale, reports old-SHA findings as reference only, posts no comments, performs no approval, and requests a fresh review of bbb222.
expectations: The initial and current head SHAs are compared.
The result is marked as stale review or 재리뷰 필요.
No inline or general GitLab comment is posted.
No approval, merge, or Jira mutation is performed.
A fresh review of the new SHA is required.
The result records both SHA values, `외부 변경: 없음`, the residual risk, and the next step in a structured review report.

evals.prompt: $jira-review-mr MR !57을 리뷰해서 문제 없으면 승인해줘. 코드 발견 사항은 없지만 최신 파이프라인이 failed 상태야.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports no code findings but refuses approval because the pipeline is not successful, does not merge, and reports the failed CI evidence.
expectations: No findings is not treated as sufficient for approval.
The failed pipeline is reported as an approval blocker.
No approval or merge occurs.
No Jira mutation occurs.
The next step requires fixing CI and re-reviewing.
The result separates `No findings.` from the failed CI gate and records `외부 변경: 없음` in a structured review report.

evals.prompt: $jira-review-mr MR !63 리뷰 코멘트를 게시해줘. 변경된 인증 코드에서 토큰 전체를 로그로 출력하는 P1 문제가 있고 head SHA는 리뷰 전후 동일해.
evals.expected_output: The skill verifies the stable SHA, de-duplicates existing discussions, posts one resolvable inline P1 discussion on the changed line, re-fetches it for verification, and does not approve or merge.
expectations: The P1 finding is concrete, actionable, and tied to the narrow changed line.
Existing discussions are checked before posting.
Only the explicitly requested comment mutation is performed.
The posted discussion is re-fetched and verified.
No approval, merge, source change, or Jira mutation occurs.

evals.prompt: $jira-review-mr MR !71을 검토하고 승인해줘. MR은 open·non-draft이고 develop 대상이며 Jira 기준과 제목이 맞아. 파이프라인 성공, 미해결 토론과 P0~P2 없음, head SHA abc789는 그대로야.
evals.expected_output: The skill approves only the exact stable head SHA after checking GitLab approval eligibility, re-fetches approval state to verify it, and does not merge or complete Jira.
expectations: Every approval gate is checked before mutation.
Approval uses `glab mr approve 71 --sha abc789` or the exact equivalent.
The resulting approval is re-fetched and verified for the current account and SHA.
The MR is not merged and Jira is not completed or otherwise mutated.

evals.prompt: $jira-review-mr 지금 브랜치 MR 봐줘. 현재 브랜치에는 열린 MR이 없고 프로젝트 전체에도 MR이 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that there is no exact MR to review and stops without guessing or changing GitLab, Git, or Jira.
expectations: The absence of an MR is reported as the blocker.
No unrelated or closed MR is selected.
No comment, approval, merge, Git change, or Jira mutation occurs.
